bigQuestions: Who are your family and friends?

units.title: Families and Friends
units.grammar: Verb Be: I am, You are, He/She is, We/They are
units.speaking: Introducing people: This is my brother. It's nice to meet you.
units.writing: Talk about your family and write about them.

units.title: Elliot's New Friend
units.grammar: Demonstratives: This, That, These, Those (This is a zebra. Those are lions.)
units.speaking: Describing friends: This is Tim. He has a hamster. We play together.
units.writing: Talk about your friend and write about him or her.

units.title: Who's in the Tree?
units.reading: Who's in the Tree? Colors of the Sky (Fiction, rhyming poems)
units.grammar: There is... / There are... (There's a black spider. There are two white kittens.)
units.speaking: Inviting and making suggestions: Let's color! OK. Good idea!
units.writing: Talk about rhyming words and write a poem with animals and colors.

units.title: Let's Make Colors!
units.grammar: Prepositions of Place: In, On, Under, Next To
units.speaking: Describing using colors: I have a yellow hat. There's a starfish next to me.
units.writing: Talk about your favorite clothes and write about them.

units.title: Animal Homes
units.grammar: Where Questions with Verb Be (Where's the eagle? Where are the chicks?)
units.speaking: Warning people: Watch out! Be careful! OK. Thanks!
units.writing: Talk about animal homes and write about one.

units.title: My Friend, Anak
units.grammar: What and Who Questions with Verb Be (What's that? Who's this?)
units.speaking: Describing animals: It's small. It's brown. It lives in the woods.
units.writing: Talk about animals and their habits and write about one.

units.title: The Four Seasons
units.grammar: Simple Present with It (It gets hot in the summer. It snows in the winter.)
units.speaking: Inviting people: Do you want to play in the snow with me? Sure! Great! Let's go!
units.writing: Talk about your favorite season and write about it.

units.title: The Seasons of Arnold's Apple Tree
units.reading: The Seasons of Arnold's Apple Tree (Realistic fiction)
units.grammar: Simple Present with I and You (In the summer, I build a tree house. Do you watch honeybees?)
units.speaking: Asking and telling about activities: What do you do in the spring? I ride a bicycle.
units.writing: Talk about what you do in different seasons and write about it.

units.title: Working with Numbers
units.grammar: Simple Present with Verb Have (I, You, We, They) (I have six shells. They don't have a pet.)
units.writing: Write about numbers in your life.

units.title: Stone Soup
units.grammar: Simple Present Questions with Verb Have (Do you have...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.)
units.writing: Retell or write about the story.

units.title: The Farmer and the Hat
units.grammar: Simple Present with Regular Verbs and Verb Have (He, She) (She needs a cow. He doesn't have a hat.)

units.title: Wants and Needs
units.grammar: Simple Present Questions with Regular Verbs and Have (Does she work in a school? What does Sana have?)

units.title: Where's Your Home?
units.grammar: Possessive 's (Jenna's house is in the country.)

units.title: City Mouse and Country Mouse
units.grammar: Possessive Adjectives (My, Your, His, Her, Our)

units.title: Percussion Instruments
units.grammar: Present Continuous (I'm playing the drum. She isn't shaking the tambourine.)
units.writing: Write about an instrument you like.

units.title: Let's Make Music!
units.grammar: Present Continuous Questions (Are you singing? Yes, I am. Is she dancing? No, she isn't.)

units.title: Living and Nonliving Things
units.grammar: Can and Can't (An animal can grow. Sneakers can't breathe.)

units.title: The Gingerbread Man
units.grammar: Should and Shouldn't (You should run away! You shouldn't stay here.)
